name: Yakovlev Yak-50
summary: Single-seat Soviet aerobatic trainer and competition type derived from the Yak-18; 314 built and twice world aerobatic champion.

wings: All-metal low-set monoplane wing with fabric-covered control surfaces
engines: Nine-cylinder Vedeneyev M-14P radial under a rounded cowl with a reduction gearbox
fuselage: Single seat under a sliding bubble canopy
Retractable main wheels; tailwheel stays exposed
tail: Fin and rudder with an exposed tailwheel

tellTales: Single-seat low-wing radial monoplane with retractable main wheels
Rounded radial cowl and sliding canopy on a tailwheel aircraft
Exposed tailwheel with tucked-up main gear in flight

confusedWith.howToTell: The Yak-52 has two seats and a retractable tricycle undercarriage; the Yak-50 is a single-seat taildragger.
The Yak-55 has fixed gear and a mid-set wing; the Yak-50 has a low wing and retractable main wheels.
The Su-26 has fixed spring gear and a mid-set wing; the Yak-50 has a low wing and retractable mains.
